name: Finance - Budget vs Actual Dashboard
description: So sánh ngân sách kế hoạch vs thực tế chi tiêu

native.query: SELECT b.category as name, b.allocated_amount as budget, b.spent_amount as spent, CASE WHEN b.allocated_amount > 0 THEN ROUND((b.spent_amount / b.allocated_amount * 100)::numeric, 1) ELSE 0 END as pct FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.finance_budgets b ORDER BY pct DESC
SELECT b.category as name, b.allocated_amount as budget, b.spent_amount as actual FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.finance_budgets b WHERE b.month = to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
